--- title: "Projection Operators" author: "Anonymous" date: today date-format: "iso" format: html: reference-location: margin embed-resources: true execute: freeze: auto --- # Set up Read in data and scales: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} task_df <- read_rds(here("data", "part1", "task.rds")) participants <- read_rds(here("data", "part1", "participants.rds")) exp1_x <- make_va_scale(data_min = -5, data_max = 5, px_min = 50, px_max = 585) exp1_y <- make_va_scale(data_min = 0, data_max = 1, px_min = 410, px_max = 15) ``` ::: # `ProjectToAxis`: Project from dot to axes We denote this task as `task5` in the configuration file. First, we get the data: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} task5_df <- task_df %>% filter(task == "task5") %>% select( participantId, task, id, data.select.x, data.select.y, slider.x, slider.y ) %>% rename( data.ans.x = data.select.x, data.ans.y = data.select.y, data.resp.x = slider.x, data.resp.y = slider.y ) %>% right_join(participants, by = join_by(participantId)) %>% # convert from data space to visual angle space mutate( va.resp.x = exp1_x$data_to_va(data.resp.x, dist_to_screen, pixelToMM), va.resp.y = exp1_y$data_to_va(data.resp.y, dist_to_screen, pixelToMM), va.ans.x = exp1_x$data_to_va(data.ans.x, dist_to_screen, pixelToMM), va.ans.y = exp1_y$data_to_va(data.ans.y, dist_to_screen, pixelToMM), ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ## `ProjectToAxisX`: Project to X-Axis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} task5_df %>% ggplot(aes(y = va.ans.y, x = va.resp.x - va.ans.x, color = participantId)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} task5_df %>% filter(va.resp.x - va.ans.x > 0.4) %>% count(participantId) %>% left_join(participants, by = join_by(participantId)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: As can be seen, there are two participants, who have `va.resp.x - va.ans.x` > 0.4. Let's also plot what the actual selected answers in data space is: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} task5_df %>% filter(va.resp.x - va.ans.x > 0.4) %>% ggplot() + geom_point(aes(x = data.resp.x, y = data.resp.y, color = "resp")) + geom_point(aes(x = data.ans.x, y = data.ans.y, color = "ans")) + facet_wrap(~participantId) + xlim(-5, 5) + ylim(0, 1) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: Recall that we are dealing with data that is already cleaned, so why are we still seeing data that is slightly shifted towards the right, for answers on the X-axis? Turns out these two participants were aligning things wrongly on the slider (i.e, they did not match the blue dot to the red dot but matched the thing on the slider to the red dot), hence the shift in their answers. **Thus, we exclude these two participants from our analysis for task 5**: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} task5.x.exclude <- c("667433338e6cc9e53c828774", "67e2f5ebbe69a58c40a5d550") ``` ::: --- Math model: $$ \begin{align} \texttt{error}_i &\sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{\text{PID}[i]}, \sigma_{i, \text{PID}[i]}) \\ \log(\sigma_{i, j}) &= \alpha_j + \log(\texttt{va.ans.y}_i) \\ \mu_j &\sim \mathcal{N}(\overline{\mu}, \overline{\sigma}^2)\\ \alpha_j &\sim N(\mu_\alpha, \sigma_\alpha) \\ \mu_\alpha, \bar{\mu} &\sim N(0, 1) \\ \sigma_\alpha, \bar{\sigma} &\sim \mathcal{N}^+(0, 1) \end{align} $$ Specify formula and prior: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} f <- bf( error_va ~ 1 + (1 | participantId), sigma ~ 1 + (1 | participantId) + offset(log(va.ans.y)) ) p <- c( prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept), prior(normal(0, 1), class = sd, group = participantId, lb = 0), prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept, dpar = "sigma"), prior(normal(0, 1), class = sd, group = participantId, dpar = "sigma", lb = 0) ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ::: Fit model: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} m.5.x.va <- task5_df %>% mutate(error_va = va.resp.x - va.ans.x) %>% # exclude the two participants who answered this task wrong filter(!participantId %in% task5.x.exclude) %>% brm( formula = f, data = ., family = gaussian(), prior = p, chains = 4, cores = 4, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), iter = 6000, file = here("analysis", "fitted_models", "part1", "task5.x"), file_refit = "on_change", save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE) ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ::: Check fit and posterior: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} summary(m.5.x.va) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Family: gaussian Links: mu = identity; sigma = log Formula: error_va ~ 1 + (1 | participantId) sigma ~ 1 + (1 | participantId) + offset(log(va.ans.y)) Data: . (Number of observations: 140) Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 6000; warmup = 3000; thin = 1; total post-warmup draws = 12000 Multilevel Hyperparameters: ~participantId (Number of levels: 14) Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS sd(Intercept) 0.04 0.01 0.02 0.06 1.00 2919 4846 sd(sigma_Intercept) 0.36 0.12 0.17 0.65 1.00 3612 4672 Regression Coefficients: Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS Intercept 0.02 0.01 -0.00 0.04 1.00 2202 3894 sigma_Intercept -4.35 0.13 -4.59 -4.08 1.00 4252 4413 Draws were sampled using sample(hmc). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1). ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} plot(m.5.x.va) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: Posterior predictive checks: ::: {.cell layout-ncol="2"} ```{.r .cell-code} pp_check(m.5.x.va, ndraws = 100) + theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.5)) + theme(text = element_text(size = 10)) -> p1 p1 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pp_check(m.5.x.va, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf") + theme(text = element_text(size = 10)) -> p2 p2 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-2.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pp_check(m.5.x.va, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf", plot_diff = TRUE) + theme(text = element_text(size = 10)) -> p3 p3 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-3.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ::: Plot existing data on top of prediction: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} # for an average participant prediction_grid <- task5_df %>% mutate(error_va = va.resp.x - va.ans.x) %>% filter(!participantId %in% task5.x.exclude) %>% data_grid( va.ans.y = seq_range(va.ans.y, n = 100), participantId = unique(participantId) ) %>% add_predicted_draws(m.5.x.va, ndraws = 1000) ggplot(prediction_grid, aes(x = va.ans.y, y = .prediction)) + stat_lineribbon( .width = c(.95, .80, .50), # alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5 ) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") + geom_point( data = filter(task5_df, !participantId %in% task5.x.exclude), aes(y = va.resp.x - va.ans.x, x = va.ans.y), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5 ) + labs( title = "Project to X-axis", y = "Error", x = "Distance to X-Axis" ) + # theme_minimal(base_size = 8) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.25, 0.4)) + theme_minimal(base_size = 4) + theme(legend.position = "none") -> p1 p1 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/Task 5 - va.ans.y)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](t3t5-Projection_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: We use a similar math model to the first part: $$ \begin{align*} \texttt{error}_i &\sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{\text{PID}[i]}, \sigma_{i, \text{PID}[i]}) \\ \log(\sigma_{i, j}) &= \alpha_j + \log(\texttt{va.ans.x}_i) \\ \alpha_j &\sim N(\mu_\alpha, \sigma_\alpha) \\ \mu_\alpha &\sim N(0, 1) \\ \sigma_\alpha &\sim N^+(0, 1) \end{align*} $$ Which corresponds to this `brms` formula and prior: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} f <- bf( error_va ~ 1 + (1 | participantId), sigma ~ 1 + (1 | participantId) + offset(log(va.ans.x)) ) p <- c( prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept), prior(normal(0, 1), class = sd, group = participantId, lb = 0), prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept, dpar = "sigma"), prior(normal(0, 1), class = sd, group = participantId, dpar = sigma, lb = 0) ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ::: Fit model: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} m.5.y.va <- task5_df %>% mutate(error_va = va.resp.y - va.ans.y) %>% brm( formula = f, data = ., family = gaussian(), prior = p, chains = 4, cores = 4, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), iter = 6000, file = here("analysis", "fitted_models", "part1", "task5.y"), file_refit = "on_change", save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE) ) ``` ::: Check fit and posterior: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} summary(m.5.y.va) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Family: gaussian Links: mu = identity; sigma = log Formula: error_va ~ 1 + (1 | participantId) sigma ~ 1 + (1 | participantId) + offset(log(va.ans.x)) Data: .
